services.name: Watercolour Studio Sessions
services.desc: is an ongoing class designed for artists who already have a foundation in watercolour and are ready to deepen their practice. Each session offers guided support, technique refinement, and thoughtful feedback while leaving space for personal exploration and individual style. It is recommended that if you are new to watercolour that you take our Foundations of Watercolour course before registering for this course. Bring your current projects or start something new-this is a relaxed, inspiring studio environment where you can build confidence, expand your skills, and stay creatively engaged week after week.
